verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page has one thin claim that workflows can be automated with webhooks, which suggests event-driven triggering rather than polling. Nothing explains how an agent subscribes to events from connected downstream apps or MCP servers. missing for 10: documentation of per-app or per-connector trigger subscriptions, a description of event payloads and delivery to the agent, webhook registration and management details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
